bio.text: Craig Honts is the Socialist Workers Party candidate for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District.

Patch reported in 2025 that Honts is a factory worker and a member of the Bakery, Confectionery, Tobacco Workers and Grain Millers union, and that he was the party's candidate for lieutenant governor on a ticket with Joanne Kuniansky.

sources.title: Husband-and-wife duo from Tennessee will run as pro-life independents for competitive N.J. seats
